\f[faceKris]\rHey! What's that on your hand?
\f[faceKris]\rOh, I can see that Professor Oak gave you a Pokédex...
\f[faceKris]\rBetter to present myself then.\nI'm Kris, a Professor Oak assistant here in Johto!
\f[faceKris]\rIt's my duty to register as many Pokémon as possible and send him the data through the Pokédex.
\f[faceKris]\rAs you're just starting, you'll give you a hand. Take these.
\f[faceKris]\rI think we should do a healthy competition to see who will register more data in the Pokédex.
\f[faceKris]\rI already caught tons of Pokémon to Professor Oak research, but to be fair with you, I'll start catching all of them once again.
\f[faceKris]\rProfessor Oak needs as much information as possible, so that will be good for him.
\f[faceKris]\rThat's settled then!\nEvery time we see each other, let's exchange our Pokédex information and see who is the best catcher around!
\f[faceKris]\rI'll start now, see you around!
